items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: Trombones was Big Green, trombone, Dicky Wells and Keg Johnson. The rhythm section was Ernest Hill, Lawrence Lucie, guitar, Teddy Wilson and me.

ctx.x: So who was on the band when you were with Benny?

With Benny? Well, Teddy Wilson, Keg Johnson, Johnny Russell, Glyn Paque Johnny Russell was a tenor player, Glyn Paque was alto and Benny. Bill Dillard trumpet, Bill Coleman trumpet. Fella by the name of Link, trumpet. He had three trumpets. Trombones was Big Green, trombone, Dicky Wells and Keg Johnson. The rhythm section was Ernest Hill, Lawrence Lucie, guitar, Teddy Wilson and me.

items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: Dickie Wells; bass player... Of course at the piano was Teddy Wilson.

ctx.x: Well at one time it was Benny Carter, Ben Webster, Johnny Russell, tenor saxophone; Stanley Payne, alto; Dick Clark was trumpet; Edgar Battle trumpet; trombone was Horton. I forget his first name.* Dickie Wells; bass player, I forget his name now, was a fat man. Of course at the piano was Teddy Wilson. Arnold Adams.
